about: A synthetic person told over eight sessions, then a fresh session with no hints (spec 050). Frozen on 2026-10-19 before specs 046-049 were built. Nothing here is a real person.

messages: Hi! I'm Sam, I work as a nurse in the cardiology ward of a hospital in Lyon.
I live with my dog, a beagle called Pixel. My sister Ana lives in Porto.
I'm training for a half marathon in May, my first one.
I run on Tuesday and Thursday mornings before my shift, and a long run on Sundays.
Correction about something I told you: my sister Ana lives in Braga, not Porto. I got it wrong.
And from now on please keep your answers short, in bullet points: I read them on my phone during breaks.
I've been vegetarian since January, so no meat or fish in any suggestion.
Also I really can't stand cilantro.
Big news: we moved from Lyon to Grenoble last week. Pixel loves the mountains.
At the new hospital I switched to night shifts, three nights a week.
I promised Ana I would send her the photos from our cousin's wedding by Friday.
My passport expires in June, I need to renew it before the summer trip to Braga.
Pixel had surgery on his back leg on Monday. The vet says he must rest for six weeks, short walks only.
The half marathon was moved to June 14 because of the floods.
Good news: I picked up the new passport yesterday, that's done.
